rounds.verdict: Do not publish as-is: coherent and clean, but the motion is timid and does not visibly express the scene's story.
filmIssues: The pull-back is too timid to read as a reveal: all six frames show essentially the full plate, including the pointing hand and swimmer, from t=0 onward, so the promised tight opening on the rejected cap and goggles never happens.
With no layer drift, entrances, or meaningful camera travel, the film is no better than a plain centred zoom — it does not make the rejection legible through motion.

The final frame is a good dwell image (full plate, swimmer from behind, hand, cap and goggles all clear), and the first frame is clean, but they are too similar for the move to feel purposeful in either direction.
No tearing, doubled edges, halos, or ghosts are visible; the cap and goggles stay coherent and together on the bench, and nothing clips the frame awkwardly.
Halftone-shimmer is fitting and subtle for the contemporary cut-paper print style.
